data.name: Fire Slash
data.description: A blazing melee slash — the blade burns red-orange and bites for fire damage.

data.name: Power Shot
data.description: A drawn-back piercing bolt — slower to ready, but it punches through for big damage.

data.name: Guard
data.description: Raise a flash-guard for a few seconds, cutting the damage you take.

data.name: Frost
data.description: An icy slash that chills the target — it crawls (slowed) for a few seconds.

data.name: Cleave
data.description: A wide, two-handed swing that cleaves through for heavy physical damage.

data.name: Arcane Bolt
data.description: A quick bolt of raw arcane force — short cooldown, reliable ranged damage.

data.name: Nova Burst
data.description: A violet nova that detonates around you — slow to charge, hits hard.

data.name: Chain Lightning
data.description: A forked bolt of lightning that arcs into the target for strong shock damage.

data.name: Bulwark
data.description: Brace behind a heavy bulwark — a long window that soaks most incoming damage.

data.name: Poison Dart
data.description: A venom-tipped shot — light hit up front, then poison eats away at the target.

data.name: Enfeeble
data.description: A draining pulse that weakens the target — its blows land softer for a while.

data.name: Mend
data.description: A burst of restorative light — mends a solid chunk of your health.

data.name: Renew
data.description: A quick top-up of health on a short cooldown — small, but always ready.
